data.name: Puddle Pals
data.detailed_description:
Puddle Pals is a cozy-chaotic multiplayer game about being a small frog in a big backyard.

Play solo or with friends as expressive little frogs who jump, swing, stack, and accidentally cause chaos. Explore a dense backyard playground full of toys, wildlife, and interactive props where physics and curiosity drive the fun.

There are no fail states, no timers, and no wrong solutions, just playful exploration and silly moments waiting to happen.

Inspired by the spirit of Untitled Goose Game, Puddle Pals focuses on mischief, movement, and player-created stories.

Key Features

  • Cozy-Chaotic Multiplayer
    Play solo or with friends in drop-in multiplayer. Explore together, cause trouble, and create ridiculous frog moments.

  • Physics-Driven Comedy
    Ride toys, bounce off objects, knock things over, and watch unexpected chain reactions unfold.

  • Expressive Frog Movement
    Leap, climb, swing, slide, stack, and flop your way through the backyard.

  • Sticker-Based Progression
    Earn stickers for memorable moments rather than perfect play. Unlock new abilities and playful upgrades.

  • No Fail States, No Timers
    Experiment freely. There are no timers, penalties, or wrong solutions.

  • A Living Backyard World
    Discover secrets, wildlife, toys, and interactive props packed into a dense playful world.

data.short_description: A cozy-chaotic co-op physics adventure where you play as frogs exploring a giant Aussie backyard. Jump, grapple, swing, stack, and cause playful chaos with toys, wildlife, and backyard contraptions in a sandbox full of silly discoveries.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Gamepad recommended.
